description: This Java source file defines an immutable command class 'SudoCountThings' used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It represents a command to count items (things) without permissions check, with options for filtering via a JSON string. The class includes methods for instantiation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and managing command headers.

classes.name: SudoCountThings
classes.description: Immutable command class to perform a sudo count of 'things' with optional filtering, serializable to/from JSON, and integrated with Ditto headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SudoCountThings instance with provided filter and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a SudoCountThings command.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the filter string if present.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.
